records.reason: Real self-buff: after you cast a domain spell you gain resistance to ALL damage equal to that spell's rank until the start of your next turn. Nothing delivers it. Domain spells are focus spells and are always heightened to half your level rounded up, so the value is exact and cannot over-grant.

mode.name: Deity's Protection
mode.duration: until the start of your next turn
mode.note: Turn this on after you cast a domain spell. The resistance equals the rank of the domain spell you cast; domain focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up.

records.reason: Reaction that swaps the outcome table of a Thievery check against a trap; GM/table adjudicated, no sheet statistic changes.
The -1/-2 circumstance penalty lands on the challenged foe's attack rolls, not on your sheet.
Grants a two-action Strike activity; the extra weapon die and the clumsy/off-guard results are resolved at the table and land on the target.
Mythic Strike activity; forced movement, collision damage and the prone save all affect the target and the environment.
Creates a hazard with DCs equal to your class DC; a table-run hazard, nothing on the character sheet changes.
Ignores 5 points of Hardness of traps and unattended objects - object-side only, no player statistic.

Self-facing package: your hair unarmed Strike's damage die steps up and it gains reach and versatile slashing (or sweep if it already had reach), and you are permanently quickened (extra action limited to a hair Strike) while your familiar is alive within 30 feet. No legal field upgrades a granted unarmed attack's damage die, adds weapon traits to it, or grants standing quickened.
Reaction that casts heal on a triggering ally to reduce that ally's damage; ally-facing only.
Stops the feinted target from flanking; a restriction on the foe, not a change to your sheet.
Reaction that lets you use a press action you already have, at the cost of your reactions; action economy only, resolved at the table.
An optional way to resolve Shield Block (double Hardness, double shield damage) chosen at the moment of the block; no persistent sheet statistic.
An activity that ignores difficult terrain and Speed penalties for its own movement and allows Athletics in place of Acrobatics to Balance; resolved when the action is used.
Spellshape that adds splash damage to creatures adjacent to the spell's target; entirely target-side.
Strike plus a Dueling Lore check that frightens the target; the effect lands on the foe.
Three-action activity making Strikes against every foe within 30 feet; multiple-attack-penalty timing is resolved at the table.

Refocus completely refills your focus pool instead of restoring 1 point - a permanent change to a resource the app tracks; the Refocus button in src/sheet/SpellsTab.tsx restores exactly 1 point. focusPoolBonus only raises the maximum, so no legal field expresses this.
A successful Feint dazzles the target; target-side condition.

Free action to attempt a Recall Knowledge check about an observed devil with shifted degrees of success; the check and the information it yields are GM-adjudicated and the feat grants no standing sheet value.

All your unarmed attacks gain the forceful and deadly d10 traits, and any that already had one increase their weapon damage dice by one step - a permanent change to every unarmed Strike shown on the Strikes tab. No legal field adds weapon traits to unarmed attacks or steps up their damage dice.
Expands Shared Stratagem to up to 10 allies; the off-guard condition and the extra 2d6 precision damage belong to those allies' attacks.

You die at dying 5 instead of dying 4. The app computes this exact number - dyingDeathThreshold() in src/rules/conditions.ts returns Math.max(1, 4 - doomed) and src/rules/play.ts drives the dying tracker from it - and Diehard appears only as a granted feat in src/rules/featFeatGrants.ts, never raising the base 4.
Creates difficult terrain in your square and lets creatures in a cone reroll persistent fire; battlefield and target-side effects only.
Modifies how the Dimensional Assault focus spell resolves (invisibility at the end of the teleport, optional Strike); a momentary effect applied when the spell is cast.
While in your hybrid shape you gain the effects of Enlarge - a toggleable self-buff (+2 status to melee damage, Large size, +5 ft reach, clumsy 1). Nothing delivers it.

mode.name: Dire Form (hybrid shape)
mode.duration: while you are in your hybrid shape
mode.note: Enlarge: you become Large (if Medium or smaller), your reach increases by 5 feet, and you are clumsy 1.

records.reason: As long as you stay in your animal shape you have the effects of Enlarge - a toggleable self-buff (+2 status to melee damage, Large size, +5 ft reach, clumsy 1) that nothing delivers.

mode.name: Dire Growth (animal shape)
mode.duration: while you remain in your animal shape
mode.note: Enlarge: you become Large (if Medium or smaller), your reach increases by 5 feet, and you are clumsy 1.

records.reason: Reshapes a composition spell's emanation into a larger cone; an area-geometry choice made at cast time, not a sheet statistic.
Changes the area of an area Heal or Harm from a burst to a cone; area geometry only.
Redirects a bomb's splash into a cone; a targeting choice whose damage lands on other creatures.
Grants a Strike-then-Disarm activity; both sub-actions are rolled at the table and the effect lands on the foe.
Free action to attempt a Disarm after a Shield Block, even without a free hand; the check and its result affect the foe's weapon.
Adds the bravado trait to the Disarm action so it can gain you panache; a trait tag on an action, with the panache gain applied by the player at the table. No statistic changes.
Grants an activity replicating your Dragon Breath for 9d6 without spending focus; the damage lands on targets and the 1d4-round recharge is tracked in play, not a per-day limited use.
The extra 1d6 sonic damage is added to your ALLIES' Strikes while they are affected by your courageous anthem; per the printed text it is ally-facing only.
Modifies the Gather Information downtime activity and sets a DC others must beat to detect you; the app does not model Gather Information.

A permanent, passive upgrade to checks the sheet owns: a success on a save against an illusion or dream effect (or on a Perception check to disbelieve an illusion) becomes a critical success, and a critical failure becomes a failure. Nothing records it. The situational registry already carries non-numeric bonus strings (derring-do's fortune text, shootists-edge's penalty text), so it is expressible there.

situational.when: against an illusion or dream effect
situational.bonus: success is a critical success; critical failure is a failure
success is a critical success; critical failure is a failure

records.reason: Mounted activity: dismount, move, then Strike for extra weapon dice; resolved at the table when the action is used.
Makes the creature you hit with a Reactive Strike off-guard; target-side condition.
Creatures damaged by your Anadi Venom save against your existing DC or become off-guard; the save and condition are on the target.
A Strike that attempts a counteract check against a spell on the target, using values derived from numbers already on the sheet (half level, class DC - 10).
Adds a counteract attempt against a spell active on the Spellstrike's target, using the standard counteract modifier; target-side.
Reaction Strike that can disrupt the prey's action on a critical hit; table-resolved and foe-facing.
Unarmed Strike inflicting persistent void damage and enfeebled on the target; all effects land on the creature struck.
A one-round self-buff whose payload is a disrupting rune's effect, which only forces a save and enfeebles undead you hit; no numeric change to your own statistics.
Prevents other creatures from taking movement-triggered reactions; a restriction on foes, not a player statistic.
Reaction forcing a save against your existing higher DC; the penalty and disruption land on the triggering caster.
Free action to regain 1 Focus Point while in darkness; the player applies it with the existing focus-pool tracker, and no persistent statistic changes.

A permanent numeric self-benefit: the range-increment penalty for bow-group weapons is reduced by 1 (minimum 0), i.e. effectively +1 to bow attack rolls made beyond the first range increment. Nothing delivers it; the situational registry already holds sibling entries (masterful-hunter, shootists-edge).

situational.when: with bow-group weapons beyond your first range increment (penalty reduction, min 0)

records.reason: Reaction granting a jump that avoids reactions plus brief water-walking; transient movement resolved at the table, and no Speed-type field covers walking on liquid.
Makes a creature bitten by your swarm off-guard against your next Strike; the condition is on the foe.
Reaction Strike outside the multiple attack penalty that can disrupt a foe's concentrate action; table-resolved and target-facing.
The -2 circumstance penalty to Perception and Reflex applies to the creature you feinted, not to you.
Create a Diversion with Performance on behalf of an ally; the benefit goes to the ally.
Lets you count larger creatures as cover for Hide and Sneak; a GM-adjudicated cover permission with no numeric statistic.
Makes your hunted prey off-guard after a crit or two hits in a turn; target-side condition.
Activity combining a ranged Feint and a thrown Strike; all outcomes are rolled at the table and land on the target.
Diving activity that deals spirit damage and pushes creatures in an area using your existing DC; damage and forced movement are target-side.

Optionally accept a -2 penalty to use Esoteric Lore for any Recall Knowledge topic, and compare an Exploit a Vulnerability result to the Recall Knowledge DC; both are GM-adjudicated Recall Knowledge outcomes, not automatic sheet changes.
Triggered free action spending a Mythic Point to survive at 10 + your level HP; applied through the existing HP and condition trackers, with no persistent statistic.
Reaction to attempt a Reposition and then Step; the Athletics check and forced movement are table-resolved.
